title: US equity markets closed — Juneteenth observed on the Friday that would otherwise be June's quarterly expiration
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200 after its 302, 109,180 bytes; the page needs curl -L and its holiday data is JSON-ish '"text":"..."' cells rather than HTML table markup) and parsed cell-by-cell by this session. The page states 'All NYSE markets observe U.S. holidays as listed below for 2026, 2027, and 2028'; against that header its Juneteenth National Independence Day row parses exactly as ['Friday, June 19', 'Friday, June 18 (Juneteenth National Independence Day observed)', 'Monday, June 19'] for 2026 / 2027 / 2028 — i.e. because 2027-06-19 falls on a Saturday, the closure is observed on Friday 2027-06-18, and that Friday is June 2027's third Friday. The same page carries no early-close footnote against this row, so it is a full closure rather than a half day. INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION OF THE MECHANIC, from the tape rather than the page: 2026's Juneteenth also falls on a Friday (2026-06-19), and that date is absent from both price series this session pulled — CBOE's own SPX_History.csv (13,028 bars) and Yahoo ^GSPC (5,957 bars). Filed estimate rather than confirmed because the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for an exchange operator's own hours page and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Discovered by the vix-expiration-2027-03-17 initial research, which read the same closure off Cboe's settlement listing and deliberately left it unproposed as 'three months out of corridor'; filed here by the lane whose corridor it is in. Checked 2026-09-05
notes: This entry exists because of what the closure DISPLACES, not because a holiday is itself tradeable. June's third Friday is normally the US quarterly equity expiration; with NYSE closed on 2027-06-18 the expiration falls back to Thursday 2027-06-17. That is the mechanism vix-expiration-2027-03-17's leg 2 used to explain an otherwise-anomalous Cboe row (VX/K7 listed on Tuesday 2027-05-18, which is 2027-06-17 minus 30 days), corroborated on the same Cboe page by a VA/M7 row dated 2027-06-17. IMPORTANT SOURCING LIMIT: the fomc-2027-06-09 lane could NOT re-source that Cboe row on 2026-09-05 (two settlement URLs returned 404), so the moved expiration date is deliberately NOT filed as its own calendar entry here — only the closure, which is NYSE-primary and verbatim, is. Registered instead as a forward test, FT-fomc-2027-06-09-2, score by 2027-06-19. WHY IT MATTERS TO THE JUNE 2027 FED WINDOW: the fomc-2027-06-09 ledger measured that the June FOMC sits one or two trading sessions before the June expiration in 12 of the last 14 years, the exceptions being 2020 (+7) and 2024 (+6). 2027 is the third exception at +6 sessions, and this closure is part of why — it pulls the expiry one session nearer while the eight-day pull-forward of the June meeting itself pushes the decision six sessions clear. The practical consequence recorded there is that the March 2027 rule of treating decision and expiry as a single event window does NOT transfer to June: a 2027-06-17 tape move has an expiry explanation and essentially nothing else, while 2027-06-10 and 2027-06-11 belong to the Bank of Japan (boj-decision-2027-06-11, estimate). Note also that 2026-06-19 is the same displacement one year earlier, already visible in the tape. Estimate widens caution only; promote on an OCC or Cboe primary that this session could not obtain.
